module.purpose: Provides the tRPC handler that lists round-robin team hosts eligible for reassignment of a booking, including pagination, delegation enrichment, and availability status.
module.summary: This module retrieves non-fixed hosts associated with a booking's event type, applies optional search and cursor pagination, enriches user calendar and delegation data, and evaluates availability for the booking's time window. It excludes the current booking host, marks each returned host as available or unavailable, tolerates the no-available-users condition, and logs other availability failures.
module.businessContext: Supports Cal.com team scheduling and round-robin host reassignment. If it fails, users cannot reliably select an eligible replacement host for an existing booking.
classes: GetRoundRobinHostsToReassignOptions (~L15-21): Defines authenticated context and input requirements for reassignment queries
functions: getTeamHostsFromDB (~L23-96): Queries, paginates, enriches, and returns event-type team hosts
getEventTypeFromDB (~L98-101): Loads the complete event type required for availability evaluation
getRoundRobinHostsToReassign (~L103-173): Builds reassignment host results with availability statuses

io: Reads booking, host, and event type records through Prisma.
Logs unexpected availability evaluation errors through the sublogger.

detail.name: getTeamHostsFromDB
detail.signature: async function getTeamHostsFromDB({ eventTypeId, organizationId, prisma, searchTerm, cursor, limit = 20, excludeUserId, }: { eventTypeId: number; organizationId: number | null; prisma: PrismaClient; searchTerm?: string; cursor?: number; limit?: number; excludeUserId?: number; })
preconditions: eventTypeId identifies the event type to query.
prisma provides host count and host retrieval operations.
limit, when provided, is used as the page size.
postconditions: The result contains hosts, totalCount, hasNextPage, and nextCursor.
Only hosts with the requested eventTypeId and isFixed equal to false are included.
When a next page exists, the returned hosts contain at most limit entries and nextCursor is the last returned user's id.
When no next page exists, nextCursor is null.
Returned users are passed through withSelectedCalendars and enrichUsersWithDelegationCredentials.
invariants: Hosts are ordered by user name ascending and then priority descending.
The totalCount is the count of records matching the filtering criteria, independent of page size.
Returned host objects expose the host isFixed value and priority, with nullish priority represented as 2.
edgeCases: If searchTerm is absent or falsy, no user name or email search filter is applied.
If excludeUserId is absent or falsy, no user exclusion filter is applied.
If cursor is absent or falsy, the query starts from the beginning without cursor skip.
If cursor is truthy, the query uses the userId_eventTypeId cursor and skips the cursor record.
If more than limit records are fetched, the extra record is removed from the returned hosts and its presence sets hasNextPage to true.
If the fetched result count is at most limit, all fetched hosts are returned and nextCursor is null.
A host with null priority is returned with priority 2.

raises: Errors rejected by prisma.host.count or prisma.host.findMany

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns an object shaped as { hosts, totalCount, hasNextPage, nextCursor }, where hosts is the delegation-credential-enriched user list with isFixed and priority fields, totalCount is numeric, hasNextPage is boolean, and nextCursor is a user id or null.
detail.summary: Retrieves non-fixed hosts for an event type with optional search, exclusion, and cursor pagination. It returns selected user data enriched with calendar and delegation credentials together with count and pagination metadata.

specLiterals.role: Default page size when limit is omitted.
Case-insensitive mode for name and email search.
Cursor pagination skip count so the cursor record is excluded.
Fallback priority when a host priority is null.

specTests.when: getTeamHostsFromDB is called with that limit.
specTests.then: The extra record is omitted from hosts, hasNextPage is true, and nextCursor equals the id of the last retained user's record.
The returned host has isFixed false and priority 2.
The host filter requires the associated user's name or email to contain the term using insensitive mode.

detail.name: getRoundRobinHostsToReassign
detail.signature: export const getRoundRobinHostsToReassign = async ({ ctx, input }: GetRoundRobinHostsToReassignOptions) =>
preconditions: ctx must provide a Prisma client and a user with an organizationId.
input must provide a bookingId and the host query parameters expected by GetRoundRobinHostsToReassignOptions.
postconditions: The returned items contain the selected host id, name, email, and either an available or unavailable status.
The returned pagination information includes nextCursor from the host query.
Hosts unavailable according to ensureAvailableUsers are still returned with status unavailable.
invariants: The booking lookup is restricted to the requested bookingId and selects userId, startTime, endTime, and eventTypeId.
The booking's userId is excluded from the team-host query when present.
A host is marked available only when its id is present among the users returned by ensureAvailableUsers.
edgeCases: If the booking does not exist, prisma.booking.findUniqueOrThrow propagates its lookup error.
If the booking has no eventTypeId, the function throws an Error with message "Booking requires a event type to reassign hosts".
If ensureAvailableUsers reports ErrorCode.NoAvailableUsersFound, all queried hosts are returned with status unavailable.
If another error occurs while loading the event type or checking availability, the error is logged and all queried hosts are treated as unavailable.
If the host query returns no hosts, items is empty and nextCursor is returned from that query.

raises: The error propagated by prisma.booking.findUniqueOrThrow when the booking cannot be found.
Error when the booking has no eventTypeId, with message "Booking requires a event type to reassign hosts".
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Booking lookup errors and the missing-event-type condition are propagated; availability-check errors other than ErrorCode.NoAvailableUsersFound are logged and converted to unavailable hosts.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Returns the host list with every host marked unavailable when availability resolution fails after the booking and host queries succeed.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns an object containing items: an array of { id, name, email, status }, where status is "available" or "unavailable", and nextCursor from the host pagination query.
